shellcheck.description: ShellCheck severity level: 'error' (only errors), 'warning' (errors+warnings), or 'all' (comprehensive - errors, warnings, info, style). Recommended: 'all' for full coverage of variable expansion, shell expansion, escape sequences, logical errors, robustness, edge cases, etc.

style.description: Enable style and best practices checks

cursor_ai.description: Enable Cursor AI agent semantic analysis. Generates prompt file for manual review with Cmd/Ctrl+K, or uses Cursor Rules for automatic analysis.

description: Pre-commit audit configuration. Exclude large generated files if needed.
